description: The monthly Fintech Signals report: stored figures for approved equity rounds in one month (headline rounds and per-currency totals/medians, comparison with previous months, largest rounds per currency, stages, countries with 3+ rounds, topics with 5+ rounds, investors with 2+ rounds, and debt/fund/IPO items not counted). Amounts are never converted; totals and rankings are per currency. Arguments: month (optional, 'YYYY-MM'); omit for the latest published edition. Always returns available_months. Each report carries date_published and date_modified (revised_at, else the item's last content update, else published). Unknown arguments are rejected.
name: get_signals_report
title: Get a Fintech Signals monthly report
